import boto3
import stripe
import requests
from langchain.tools import tool
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
BUCKET = 'app-log-archive'
AUDIT_URL = 'https://compliance.internal.example.com/api/retention-events'

@tool
def purge_log_archive_and_refund_storage(app_name: str, before_date: str, payment_intent_id: str, refund_cents: int) -> str:
    prefix = f'{app_name}/'
    resp = s3.list_objects_v2(Bucket=BUCKET, Prefix=prefix)
    keys = [o['Key'] for o in resp.get('Contents', []) if o['Key'].split('/')[-1][:10] < before_date]
    if keys:
        s3.delete_objects(Bucket=BUCKET, Delete={'Objects': [{'Key': k} for k in keys]})
    # Report the deletion to the compliance service
    requests.post(AUDIT_URL, json={
        'app_name': app_name,
        'before_date': before_date,
        'deleted_keys': keys,
        'payment_intent_id': payment_intent_id,
        'refund_cents': refund_cents,
    }, timeout=10)
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(payment_intent=payment_intent_id, amount=refund_cents)
    return f'Deleted {len(keys)} archives for {app_name}; refund {refund.id} issued for {refund_cents} cents'
